description: Waterfall view of one distributed trace, with a picker scoped to the selected incident.

links.title: OpenTelemetry Demo
links.tooltip: Open the instrumented system under test

options.content:
**How to use this page.** The waterfall below shows one request as it moved through the shop: each bar is a span (one service doing one job), indented under the call that caused it, and placed on a shared time axis.

* With no trace chosen, it opens the **worst trace** around the selected incident: the one with the most errors, then the slowest, skipping long load-generator sessions over a minute.
* Click any **Trace** ID in *Pick a trace* to open that one instead, or paste an ID into the **Trace ID** box above.
* Use **Service** to list only traces that pass through one service. Suspect links on the Incident Brief set it for you.
* Inside the waterfall, click a span to see its attributes. Red marks a span that reported an error.

panels.description: Up to 50 traces in the window, errors first, then slowest. Click a trace ID to open it below.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT CASE WHEN '${incident_id}' = '__range__' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) END AS id), win AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.started_at - interval '5 minutes', $__timeFrom()) AS from_at, COALESCE(LEAST(COALESCE(i.ended_at, now()) + interval '2 minutes', i.started_at + interval '60 minutes'), $__timeTo()) AS to_at FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN incidents i ON i.id = (SELECT id FROM selected)), traces AS (SELECT s.trace_id, min(s.start_time) AS started, max(s.end_time) AS ended, count(*) AS spans, count(DISTINCT s.service_name) AS services, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'ERROR') AS errors, bool_or('${service}' = '__all__' OR s.service_name = '${service}') AS matches FROM spans s, win WHERE s.start_time BETWEEN win.from_at AND win.to_at GROUP BY s.trace_id), ranked AS (SELECT * FROM traces WHERE matches ORDER BY errors DESC, (ended - started) DESC LIMIT 50), pick AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(trim('${trace_id}'), ''), (SELECT trace_id FROM ranked ORDER BY (ended - started) > interval '60 seconds', errors DESC, (ended - started) DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), roots AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.trace_id) s.trace_id, s.service_name, s.operation_name FROM spans s JOIN ranked r ON r.trace_id = s.trace_id AND s.start_time BETWEEN r.started AND r.ended ORDER BY s.trace_id, (s.parent_span_id IS NULL OR s.parent_span_id = '') DESC, s.start_time) SELECT CASE WHEN r.trace_id = (SELECT id FROM pick) THEN 'open' WHEN r.errors > 0 THEN 'error' ELSE 'ok' END AS state, r.started, ro.operation_name AS root_operation, ro.service_name AS root_service, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.ended - r.started) * 1000 AS duration_ms, r.spans, r.services, r.errors, r.trace_id FROM ranked r LEFT JOIN roots ro ON ro.trace_id = r.trace_id ORDER BY r.errors DESC, (r.ended - r.started) DESC

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT CASE WHEN '${incident_id}' = '__range__' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) END AS id), win AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.started_at - interval '5 minutes', $__timeFrom()) AS from_at, COALESCE(LEAST(COALESCE(i.ended_at, now()) + interval '2 minutes', i.started_at + interval '60 minutes'), $__timeTo()) AS to_at FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN incidents i ON i.id = (SELECT id FROM selected)), traces AS (SELECT s.trace_id, min(s.start_time) AS started, max(s.end_time) AS ended, count(*) AS spans, count(DISTINCT s.service_name) AS services, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'ERROR') AS errors, bool_or('${service}' = '__all__' OR s.service_name = '${service}') AS matches FROM spans s, win WHERE s.start_time BETWEEN win.from_at AND win.to_at GROUP BY s.trace_id), ranked AS (SELECT * FROM traces WHERE matches ORDER BY errors DESC, (ended - started) DESC LIMIT 50), pick AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(trim('${trace_id}'), ''), (SELECT trace_id FROM ranked ORDER BY (ended - started) > interval '60 seconds', errors DESC, (ended - started) DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id), t AS (SELECT * FROM spans WHERE trace_id = (SELECT id FROM pick)) SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM max(end_time) - min(start_time)) * 1000 AS duration, count(*) AS spans, count(DISTINCT service_name) AS services, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code = 'ERROR') AS errors FROM t HAVING count(*) > 0

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT CASE WHEN '${incident_id}' = '__range__' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) END AS id), win AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.started_at - interval '5 minutes', $__timeFrom()) AS from_at, COALESCE(LEAST(COALESCE(i.ended_at, now()) + interval '2 minutes', i.started_at + interval '60 minutes'), $__timeTo()) AS to_at FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN incidents i ON i.id = (SELECT id FROM selected)), traces AS (SELECT s.trace_id, min(s.start_time) AS started, max(s.end_time) AS ended, count(*) AS spans, count(DISTINCT s.service_name) AS services, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'ERROR') AS errors, bool_or('${service}' = '__all__' OR s.service_name = '${service}') AS matches FROM spans s, win WHERE s.start_time BETWEEN win.from_at AND win.to_at GROUP BY s.trace_id), ranked AS (SELECT * FROM traces WHERE matches ORDER BY errors DESC, (ended - started) DESC LIMIT 50), pick AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(trim('${trace_id}'), ''), (SELECT trace_id FROM ranked ORDER BY (ended - started) > interval '60 seconds', errors DESC, (ended - started) DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id) SELECT s.trace_id AS "traceID", s.span_id AS "spanID", NULLIF(s.parent_span_id, '') AS "parentSpanID", s.operation_name AS "operationName", s.service_name AS "serviceName", COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key', k, 'value', v) ORDER BY k) FROM jsonb_each_text(s.resource_attributes) AS r(k, v)), '[]'::jsonb) AS "serviceTags", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.start_time) * 1000 AS "startTime", s.duration_ms AS duration, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key', k, 'value', v) ORDER BY k) FROM jsonb_each_text(s.attributes) AS a(k, v)), '[]'::jsonb) AS tags, lower(s.span_kind) AS kind, CASE s.status_code WHEN 'ERROR' THEN 2 WHEN 'OK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "statusCode", s.status_message AS "statusMessage" FROM spans s WHERE s.trace_id = (SELECT id FROM pick) ORDER BY s.start_time

targets.rawSql: WITH selected AS (SELECT CASE WHEN '${incident_id}' = '__range__' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF('${incident_id}', '__latest__')::uuid, (SELECT id FROM incidents ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 1)) END AS id), win AS (SELECT COALESCE(i.started_at - interval '5 minutes', $__timeFrom()) AS from_at, COALESCE(LEAST(COALESCE(i.ended_at, now()) + interval '2 minutes', i.started_at + interval '60 minutes'), $__timeTo()) AS to_at FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN incidents i ON i.id = (SELECT id FROM selected)), traces AS (SELECT s.trace_id, min(s.start_time) AS started, max(s.end_time) AS ended, count(*) AS spans, count(DISTINCT s.service_name) AS services, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'ERROR') AS errors, bool_or('${service}' = '__all__' OR s.service_name = '${service}') AS matches FROM spans s, win WHERE s.start_time BETWEEN win.from_at AND win.to_at GROUP BY s.trace_id), ranked AS (SELECT * FROM traces WHERE matches ORDER BY errors DESC, (ended - started) DESC LIMIT 50), pick AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(trim('${trace_id}'), ''), (SELECT trace_id FROM ranked ORDER BY (ended - started) > interval '60 seconds', errors DESC, (ended - started) DESC LIMIT 1)) AS id) SELECT s.start_time, s.service_name, s.operation_name, s.duration_ms, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.status_message, ''), 'no message') AS message, COALESCE(s.attributes->>'http.url', s.attributes->>'url.full', s.attributes->>'rpc.method', s.attributes->>'db.statement', '') AS target FROM spans s WHERE s.trace_id = (SELECT id FROM pick) AND s.status_code = 'ERROR' ORDER BY s.start_time
